subject: Temporary quota bridge & prorated overrun settlement
messages:
From: Sasha Lee <sasha@brightboard.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightBoard Contracts <contracts@brightboard.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent capacity request — weekend surge

Hi Evelyn,

We just saw a 6x traffic spike in our customer-facing summarization pipeline and we're on track to blow through our daily quota by this afternoon. Our engineers have throttled noncritical jobs but we still need a short window of higher throughput to prevent degraded experience for paying users over the weekend.

Question: can Redwood provide a short-term burst (24-72 hrs) and invoice us for the overrun, or do we need to upgrade to a higher committed tier before we can scale? We want to avoid hitting rate limits tonight.

We're happy to sign any short-term paperwork or pay a prorated bill — need a quick path.

Thanks,
Sasha Lee
Head of Platform
BrightBoard Inc.
[attachment: traffic_snapshot_20270809.json (application/json)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Lee <sasha@brightboard.com>
Cc: BrightBoard Contracts <contracts@brightboard.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent capacity request — weekend surge

Hi Sasha — thanks for the heads up and sorry about the churn. We can absolutely avoid hard rate limits for the weekend. Proposed short-term path below: 

- Temporary quota bridge: 72-hour burst window starting as soon as you confirm.
- Cap: up to 15M tokens total during the window (we can raise/lower by request).
- Billing: prorated overrun at $0.0115/token for tokens above current quota; will be invoiced as a one-line overrun on next monthly invoice.
- True-up: If BrightBoard increases committed capacity within 30 days (≥2x current commit), Redwood will apply a one-time retroactive credit equal to 12% of the billed overrun amount.
- Admin fee: $250 one-time (waivable by Sales Ops).

Next steps: 1) Reply to this thread to confirm you want us to enable the bridge now, 2) Contracts can approve the short addendum (I attached a one-page bridge_terms_20270809.pdf), and 3) we'll enable capacity and send a proforma invoice.

If you'd like a firmer SLA during the bridge window (latency targets), let me know — we can scope that but it will change the rate.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: bridge_terms_20270809.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: BrightBoard overrun proposal — recommended edits

Eve / Karthik — quick internal note before we finalize:

- Drop the admin fee (waive the $250).
- Shift the retroactive credit to 20% (not 12%) if they commit to ≥1.5x current capacity for the next quarter — stronger incentive and still within margin guardrails.
- Keep the per-token overrun price at $0.0115 but add a soft cap: after $50k of overrun charges we automatically pause and require explicit approval to continue.

If you both are good with that, I'll approve the proforma and route to finance for Net30.

Ben
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 13:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: temporary bridge + billing path for BrightBoard (BB-4391)

Hi Sasha — following internal review, thanks for the quick coordination. Confirming final terms below (effective once you reply "CONFIRM" to this thread):

- Window: 72 hours from activation.
- Cap: 15M tokens during window.
- Overrun rate: $0.0115/token for usage above your active quota.
- Safety stop: automatic pause if overrun charges exceed $50,000; we'll notify you and can escalate for approval to continue.
- Credit: 20% retro credit applied to the billed overrun if BrightBoard upgrades committed capacity to at least 1.5x current within 30 days.
- Admin fee: waived.
- Billing: Proforma invoice attached (proforma_invoice_BB4391.pdf). Final invoice on your regular cycle (Net30).

DocuSign link for the addendum: https://docusign.com/transactions/3f7a2c
Proforma (view): https://redwood-inference.app/invoices/BB-4391/proforma

Please reply with CONFIRM and we will flip the bridge ON immediately.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
